title: processBlock wiring for M/S, sidechain, lookahead, CMakeLists
description:
Wire MidSideRouter, SidechainAnalyzer, MaskingCarver, MonoGuard, and LookaheadDelay into PluginProcessor processBlock / prepareToPlay and register all phase-H sources in CMakeLists.txt. This task is the sole owner of PluginProcessor.* and CMakeLists.txt for phase H.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §10, §11, §19.2 (sidechain host-only; stage-level M/S; optional lookahead PDC)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §18 (audio thread: no heap/locks; sidechain skip when absent)
- Source/DSP/MidSideRouter.*, SidechainAnalyzer.*, MaskingCarver.*, MonoGuard.*, LookaheadDelay.* public APIs from h.1–h.4
- Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp existing prepareToPlay/processBlock order (TightCut, Chug, parametric, multiband, resonance, etc.)
- Source/ParameterIDs.h lookahead, sideHighPass, monoGuard*, lockIn/carve sidechain IDs (read only — do not reinvent IDs file)
- CMakeLists.txt append patterns from phases B–G
- BusesProperties / isBusesLayoutSupported sidechain handling from phase A (standalone without sidechain must remain safe)

Wire Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp:
1. Own by-value members: MidSideRouter, SidechainAnalyzer, MaskingCarver, MonoGuard, LookaheadDelay (names consistent with existing style).
2. prepareToPlay/releaseResources/reset: prepare all five with sampleRate/maxBlockSize/channel counts; reset on release as needed.
3. Lookahead: read lookahead mode from APVTS; set LookaheadDelay mode; call setLatencySamples(lookaheadDelay.getLatencySamples()) whenever mode or sample rate changes so host PDC matches exact delay. Off → 0.
4. processBlock signal order (document chosen order in a short comment): apply LookaheadDelay on main input early enough that downstream dynamics can use delayed dry versus sidechain/detector timing as designed; obtain sidechain bus buffers via getBusBuffer when layout has sidechain, else skip analyzer push and idle carver (standalone-safe); drive SidechainAnalyzer with main+sidechain; drive MaskingCarver on audible path only for enabled carve bands; wrap parametric (and any stage marked M/S) with MidSideRouter encode → stages → decode once; run MonoGuard analyze and optional protection on side path without double-encoding; honor global bypass.
5. Push APVTS parameters each block (or on change) for side HPF, mono guard enable/protection, lock-in/carve controls, lookahead mode — no heap.
6. Do not rewrite upstream DSP algorithms beyond member wiring and parameter plumbing.

CMakeLists.txt:
1. Append Source/DSP/MidSideRouter.cpp, SidechainAnalyzer.cpp, MaskingCarver.cpp, MonoGuard.cpp, LookaheadDelay.cpp to plugin/DSP targets.
2. Append tests/MidSideTests.cpp and tests/LookaheadTests.cpp to the test target (h.6 owns test bodies).
3. Append-only minimal edits — no preset/target rename churn.

Do not implement unit test bodies. verification_commands left empty.
acceptance_criteria: Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp own MidSideRouter, SidechainAnalyzer, MaskingCarver, MonoGuard, and LookaheadDelay members prepared in prepareToPlay
processBlock performs stage-level MidSideRouter encode/decode once around the parametric/M-S stages; applies MaskingCarver only for enabled bands; runs MonoGuard protection only when enabled
LookaheadDelay mode is applied from parameters and AudioProcessor::setLatencySamples is called with LookaheadDelay::getLatencySamples() (0 when Off)
External sidechain bus is used when present and gracefully skipped in standalone / no-sidechain layouts
CMakeLists.txt lists MidSideRouter.cpp, SidechainAnalyzer.cpp, MaskingCarver.cpp, MonoGuard.cpp, LookaheadDelay.cpp, tests/MidSideTests.cpp, and tests/LookaheadTests.cpp on the correct targets
No heap allocation or mutex waits on the wired audio path; global bypass still silences module effects appropriately
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: rewrite Source/DSP/SidechainAnalyzer.* or Source/DSP/MaskingCarver.* metric/carve algorithms
modify tests/MidSideTests.cpp or tests/LookaheadTests.cpp bodies (h.6 owns content)
broad CMake restructure or rename plugin targets
hidden latency not reported via setLatencySamples

allowed: embed phase-H DSP modules by value on the processor
document one coherent processBlock order for lookahead → sidechain analyze → M/S wrap → mono guard → carve
append-only CMake target_sources for phase-H files and test stubs
skip sidechain analyzer when bus disabled or channel count zero
forbidden: GUI collision map / Mono Guard meter painting
